data.narrative:
Muon Space, a Series B-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $188M to date, is valued here using a peer-relative framework anchored to 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: Sierra Space ($8.0B Series C), Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B Series B), Aalyria ($1.3B Series B), and Skyryse ($1.1B Series C).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B advancement, yields $357M. Peer-median methodology, based on the median valuation of the four comparables, implies $1.6B. Public-comparable anchoring using the Space & Aerospace sector's 27.4x P/S median (across 5 tickers: RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) cannot be applied due to absence of disclosed target revenue. These two methods triangulate to a range of $304M (low), $1.0B (median), and $1.9B (high). The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around stage-specific discount rates relative to later-stage peers and the composition risk within the 4-company peer set, where valuations span $1.1B to $8.0B.
